content.text: FacebookLog InLog InForgot Account?UDUB Dawg House's PostUDUB Dawg HouseApril 14 at 10:41 PM · Shared with PublicThe Seattle Mariners are set to face the San Diego Padres in game one of the Vedder Cup. Having secured the Vedder Cup title last year with a 5-1 record against the Padres, the Mariners will maintain their traditional lineup against right-handed pitchers. Notably, the Mariners' offense has consistently delivered strong performances, scoring six or more runs in all four games during their sweep of the Houston Astros. Bryan Woo will take the mound for the Mariners, boasting a 0-1 record and a 1.50 ERA this season.
